reuse_vs_independence: Allocate explicitly; repeated cycles, repeated angles and video frames never increase independent specimen count.
repeat_expansion: Preparation once per allocated object; condition route once per condition/attempt with the qualified finite LOAD_CYCLE schedule. Unknown counts cannot expand as empty success.

alternative_incoming_route.does_not_mean: Unseen fabrication was robot-performed; no omission from whole-paper scope
